systems.platform: online platform connecting schools to DPEI
systems.owner: Ministry of Education, Directorate of Planning and Education Innovation (DPEI)

note: The ICR (2019) describes the national EMIS (SIGE) as a school-to-ministry data-capture system and states no link, exchange or shared learner identifier with the examinations body, payroll, learner registration or national ID; EMIS alone is class other.
